patthana22.30:1.1: āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi. na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ
patthana22.30:2.1: no āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassana sappaṭigho no āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā ekavīsa. na sanidasasna
patthana22.30:3.1: sappaṭighaṃ na sāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassana sappaṭigho sāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā ekavīsa.
patthana22.30:5.1: na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na āsavasampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassana appaṭigho āsavasampayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana22.30:6.1: na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ āsavavippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassana sappaṭigho āsavavippayutto dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. ekavīsa. na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na āsavañceva
patthana22.30:7.1: na anāsavaṃ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassana appaṭigho āsavo ceva sāsavo ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana22.30:8.1: na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na anāsavañceva na no ca āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassana sappaṭigho sāsavo ceva no ca āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā ekavīsa. na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na āsavañceva
patthana22.30:9.1: na āsavavippayuttaṃ ca dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassana appaṭigho āsavo ceva āsavasampayutto ca dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana22.30:10.1: na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na āsavavippayuttañceva na no ca āsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassana appaṭigho āsavasampayutto ceva no ca āsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana22.30:11.1: na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ āsavavippayuttaṃ na sāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca sanidassana sappaṭigho āsavavippayutto sāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. ekavīsa
patthana22.30:12.1: na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ āsavavippayuttaṃ na anāsavaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassana appaṭigho āsavavippayutto anāsavo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi. na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ no saññojanaṃ
